get_config_files: get config YAML file paths from a list or glob pattern while excluding specified folders
create_model: create a frozen detection model from a config object and move it to the specified device
create_random_input: create random tensor inputs shaped by the config MIN_SIZE_TRAIN values as an image list
test_build_detectors: test that all detection models build successfully from config files on the given device
test_run_selected_detectors: test that selected detection models build and run inference on random inputs correctly
